basis: The foundation page of the Songeun Cultural Foundation says it was set up in 1989 with the private funds of its founder.
The Seoul city ordinance on the museum (No. 9736, in force 14 July 2025) vests its permits and approvals in the Seoul mayor, and the museum's own regulations page lists the ordinance.
The foundation page of the museum describes the Whanki Foundation as a non-profit public-interest foundation corporation founded by Kim Hyang-an, the artist's widow, which runs the museum.
The foundation's organisation chart lists the art center as one of its affiliated institutions and its history page calls the foundation a public cultural foundation.

The museum's regulations page lists the statutes of the Fundació Privada Antoni Tàpies together with the Catalan foundation protectorate law, the public sector contracts law and the transparency laws.

The foundation's transparency page, read as a web.archive.org copy because the live site refuses curl, calls it a private civil foundation under the protectorate of the Generalitat de Catalunya and subject to Law 19/2013.
Hangar's site says it has been managed by Fundació Privada AAVC since 2003 and the Generalitat's foundation register certificate of 26 April 2024 confirms that foundation's registration.

governance.parent: Institut de Cultura de Barcelona (Barcelona City Council)
controls: approval of programme, loans or disposals by a ministry or council

basis: A Barcelona city gazette agreement says the Institut de Cultura de Barcelona programmes La Virreina, and the Institute's 2005 statutes (articles 18, 21 and 27) set staff, contracting, and council approval of budget, credit operations and property disposals.

The consortium statutes published in July 2015 and listed on MACBA's own page make it a local public-law body attached to the City Council (article 1), with the General Council naming the director (11h), approving the budget (23.1), staffing it with seconded civil servants and own labour staff (22) and tendering under public sector contracts law (26.2).
The legal notice of sonar.es names Advanced Music, S.L., entered in the Barcelona company registry, as the company that carries out and sells the Sónar activities.
